description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Sets ONE network's tag on flayr.social (network, id, enabled, conversion references). Fields left out keep their saved value. A tag turns on only after the consent decision is recorded. Audited in Ads > Agent activity. Spends nothing. Pass agentName and reason. Site-wide: the connected account must be a flayr super-admin, or its brand must be in FLAYR_SITE_TAG_BRAND_IDS (else ADS_SITE_TAG_NOT_ALLOWED). Needs the ads:manage scope.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/site-tags.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

contentViewConversionId.description: X and Google only: the content view conversion reference.

id.description: The tag id the site loads (TikTok: the pixel code).

pageViewConversionId.description: X and Google only: the page view conversion reference.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

signupConversionId.description: The network's sign-up conversion reference, where it has one.

name: ads_site_tag_set
title: Set one site ad tag
